skipTests.core*stop.test.ts: TEMPORARY: elysia 1.4.28 asserts (error as Error).message === 'Unable to connect' on a fetch() connection-refused error, but fetch() network errors now reject as TypeError('fetch failed', {cause}) per the Fetch spec and Node/undici (oven-sh/bun#35988); the descriptive text lives on error.cause.message and error.code === 'ECONNREFUSED'. Remove this skip once elysia checks error.code or error.cause.message instead.

Fixed upstream in elysiajs/elysia#1908; remove this skip on the next elysia bump. (glob * = path separator, so it also matches Windows backslash paths)
